name: @sebela/api-client-python
description: The Python client of the content API, generated from its OpenAPI document: pnpm and Turborepo task wrappers; Python metadata lives in pyproject.toml.

scripts.generate: uv run --locked openapi-python-client generate --path ../api-client/src/generated/openapi.json --meta none --config content-api-client.yaml --output-path src/sebela_api_client --overwrite && printf '# Marker file for PEP 561\n' > src/sebela_api_client/py.typed
